title: David Senra - Passion & Pain - [Invest Like the Best, EP.292]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: David has studied history’s great founders and entrepreneurs in more depth than anyone I’ve ever met.
reader_summary.overview: David has studied history’s great founders and entrepreneurs in more depth than anyone I’ve ever met, and I’d wager more than anyone else alive. In this conversation, we cover many of the most common themes he’s discovered studying hundreds of entrepreneurs like Estée Lauder, John Rockefeller, Enzo Ferrari. I found this to be one of the most energizing conversations I’ve had in a long time, and one I’ll return to often.

key_points.text: In this conversation, we cover many of the most common themes he’s discovered studying hundreds of entrepreneurs like Estée Lauder, John Rockefeller, Enzo Ferrari.
David’s work and extraordinary energy aligns so well with our mission at Colossus that we’re excited to partner with him.
You’ll soon be able to find his podcasts and transcripts at joincolossus.com where we hope you’ll learn as much from him as we have..
